description: The Microsoft AI for Good Lab building-damage predictions summed per Jamaican parish, on the OCHA / Jamaica Social Development Commission COD-AB administrative level 1 polygons (14 parishes, P-codes JM01-JM14). Five parishes have any assessed footprints: Westmoreland (41,214 predicted damaged of 68,826 footprints across three assessments), Saint James (22,133 of 70,791), Saint Elizabeth (16,858 of 90,184, 51,389 of them cloud-obscured on 2025-10-29), Hanover (1,031 of 3,137) and Trelawny (63 of 304); the other nine parishes were not imaged and show zeros, not "no damage". Totals sum the four imagery assessments (Vantor 2025-10-29 and 2025-10-31, NOAA NGS 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-02), so buildings imaged twice are counted twice; per-assessment columns are included. AI predictions from overhead imagery, not ground assessments. Join to other Jamaica layers on adm1_pcode or adm1_name. Sources: building damage on HDX and Jamaica COD-AB on HDX, retrieved 2026-09-23.
